mech_note: A ring (Manald Heal) whose forgotten secondary property becomes the entire build: lightning-damage attacks roll a 30-40% chance to proc Paralysis (stun), and every Paralysis stun triggers Manald Heal's hidden on-stun damage — a percentage of max life as lightning. The hidden proc multiplied by Tal Rasha Meteor set stacking, then by Fazula's cube bonus and Convention of Elements, created damage 100-1000x above documented numbers. Emerged in Patch 2.4.3 (Season 10) as a surprise top-tier discovery. The entire build is built around a proc-chain: cast lightning → stun → Manald procs → Tal Rasha stacks. Paralysis uptime (needing 4/5+ stuns per second) required extremely high attack rate (Explosive Blast spamming or Black Hole Blazar). Nerfed in 2.5.0 but remained viable into Season 13.

mech_note: Skeleton army (Necromancer) supported by Primalist's Shaman totems and spirit buffs — GD's classic undead-legion army with an unusual secondary mastery choice. Ritualist (Necromancer + Shaman) uses Bane of the Winter King set or generic pet-scaling items. Shaman adds Briarthorn (melee pet), Conjure Primal Spirit (big boss-killer), and Wendigo Totem (healing totem for the army). The army composition: skeletal warriors (melee frontline), skeletal mages (ranged), Death Knight upgrade (elite fighter), plus Shaman pets. The healing totem extends army survivability significantly in Shattered Realm. Fragile summons in numbers — individual skeletons die but the player immediately resummoned. Trade-off vs. Conjurer pet builds: more summon variety, less raw pet power. A solid entry-point army build.
